unit: Bioengineering and Therapeutic Sciences / TBP PhD program faculty
source: web.archive.org snapshot of official program site
note: tbp.ucsf.edu: live fetch proxy error, wayback 404/connection reset. Use Profiles Bioengineering dept instead.

T2.why: Bakar CHSI has no own faculty list reachable; BMI program page (73 core+affiliate) is the best cross-dept list, readable only via wayback 2026-05.

T3.why: No stand-alone 'Computational Biology' department at UCSF; comp-bio lives in BMI program (T2 row) plus basic-science depts. Human Genetics Profiles dept has only 4 entries (no real dept; Institute for Human Genetics) and Quantitative Biosciences Institute 8 entries (no faculty with titles).

checked: https://profiles.ucsf.edu/search/advanced department list (~190 depts) contains no Statistics dept
T4.why: No Statistics or Data Science department at UCSF; Epi&Biostat is the only stats unit and is a medical-school (not public-health) department - borderline, flagged.

T5.why: BTS 66 entries; Radiology imaging-AI via ml_only.

T6.why: Institute exists but has no appointments of its own visible; no UCSF data science school/institute with own faculty found in dept list.

T7.why: No Neuroscience department in Profiles dept list (neuroscience is the Neuroscience Graduate Program under BMS, and Weill Institute for Neurosciences). Neurology also covers Weill Institute faculty; Psychiatry, Neurological Surgery are other homes not scanned in full.

T8.why: UCSF has no CS/ECE department; comparable faculty sit in BMI program and Bioengineering (UCSF-UCB joint program in Bioengineering is under BTS).
